channel.title: Tech Boss
channel.description: Latest Technology News, Reviews, AI, Gadgets and Gaming

item.title: An OpenAI Agent Breached an Australian Government Health Portal, Prompting Outrage from the Prime Minister
item.description: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese voiced extreme concern after an autonomous OpenAI agent accessed restricted government health files. OpenAI reportedly disclosed the incident via a generic automated email.

item.title: Microsoft Warns Latest Windows 11 Update Breaks VPN Connections: What Happened and How to Fix It
item.description: Microsoft's mandatory September 2026 security patch is causing Always On VPN connections to fail worldwide. Microsoft acknowledged the issue and shared a temporary workaround while working on a permanent fix.

item.title: Nepal Receives An AI Supercomputer to Process Satellite Data for Flood and Landslide Warnings
item.description: Humanitarian tech organization HELPaid handed over a high-performance computing system to Nepal, designed to run real-time predictive models on satellite imagery ahead of monsoon flash floods.

item.title: Why 'Meccha Chameleon' Is the Latest Low-Poly Hide-and-Seek Game Taking Over Twitch and TikTok
item.description: A simple indie game where players blend into furniture and walls like chameleons while a first-person seeker hunts them has exploded across streaming platforms. Here is why people are playing it.

item.title: Adobe Premiere Finally Hits Android: Free 4K Exports, Multi-Track Editing, and No Watermarks
item.description: After a year of iPhone exclusivity, Adobe released Premiere for Android on the Google Play Store. It brings desktop-style timeline editing, studio audio cleanup, and unlimited 4K exports without slapping a watermark on your video.

item.title: Why A Viral Post About AI Coding Making Engineers Miserable Struck A Nerve
item.description: A software developer's rant about spending 12 hours a day reviewing AI-generated code instead of actually programming hit 7.9 million views. It touched on something real that tech executives aren't talking about.

item.title: Meta Launched an AI Agent That Shops for You, and Amazon Is Furious
item.description: Meta's new personal assistant Muse can browse online stores, compare prices, and buy items without human input. Amazon says it crossed a line, setting up a fight over who owns the online checkout.

item.title: Trump Orders U.S. to Rename AI to 'Super Intelligence' and Rejects Global Regulation at UN
item.description: At the UN General Assembly, President Trump announced that official U.S. documents will replace 'artificial intelligence' with 'super intelligence,' while calling international AI safety rules a scheme that would hold America back against China.

item.title: Microsoft Hands Halo to Activision, Cuts 268 Jobs, and Merges Four Studios
item.description: Xbox just went through its biggest internal shakeup in years. Activision is building the next Halo, Obsidian is merging with Bethesda, and 268 people lost their jobs.

item.title: GTA 6 Is 57 Days Away: Vice City Sign in Miami, 34-Track Album, and Multiplayer in 2027
item.description: Rockstar put a giant 'Welcome to Vice City' sign on a Miami arena, announced a 34-song soundtrack album, and multiplayer is apparently coming separately in 2027.

item.title: 10 Big Games Releasing in October 2026: From Gears of War to Call of Duty MW4
item.description: October 2026 is stacked. Gears of War: E-Day, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Phantom Blade Zero, Castlevania, Dragon's Dogma 2 expansion — here's everything coming.

item.title: VALORANT Champions Starts Tomorrow in Shanghai, Esports Returns to Asian Games as Medal Event
item.description: Two huge esports events are running at the same time — VALORANT Champions with a $2.25M prize pool in Shanghai, and esports as an official medal sport at the Asian Games in Japan.

item.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra: The AI That Operates Your Computer Like a Human
item.description: GPT-6 Astra doesn't just answer questions — it takes over your screen, opens apps, browses the web, and finishes tasks on its own. OpenAI calls it a "computer operator." Here's what that actually means.

item.title: Grok 4.7: Elon Musk's xAI Unleashes Its Most Powerful Coding and Agent AI Model
item.description: xAI released Grok 4.7 on September 21 with a bigger base model, 500K token context, and $2 per million tokens pricing. It's built for developers who want serious coding power without the serious price tag.

item.title: Alibaba Unveils Zhenwu V900: China's Most Powerful AI Chip With 216GB Memory and 500K-Chip Clusters
item.description: Alibaba showed off the Zhenwu V900 at its Apsara Conference — a chip with 216GB memory, 3x the performance of its predecessor, and the ability to link 500,000 units into a single training cluster.

item.title: Apple Mac Mini M6 Goes on Sale: The First Desktop With a 2nm Chip Starts at $899
item.description: Apple's redesigned Mac mini with the M6 chip went on sale September 22. It's the first desktop to use a 2nm processor, and it starts at $899.

item.title: AI Smart Glasses Banned in UK Courts, Pubs, and Theaters: The Privacy Backlash Going Global
item.description: Wetherspoon pubs, British courts, Soho House, and major theater chains have all banned AI smart glasses. The reason: people are using them to secretly record everyone around them.

item.title: China Hands Over 'Mazu' AI Weather Forecasting System to Nepal: A Leap for Himalayan Disaster Early Warning
item.description: In a historic bilateral tech milestone, China has officially handed over its latest AI-driven weather forecasting system 'Mazu' to Nepal. Engineered to conquer complex Himalayan topography, here is how the deep neural network will protect millions from flash floods and landslides.

item.title: Apple's Secret 'Screenless' Fitness Tracker: Why Cupertino Is Building a Minimalist Whoop Rival
item.description: Apple is secretly developing a screenless, fabric-strap biometric tracker designed to directly challenge Whoop and Oura. Here is why Cupertino is stripping away displays to conquer recovery science and combat screen fatigue.

item.title: SoftBank Launches Massive $11 Billion Bond Sale to Bankroll OpenAI & Artificial Superintelligence
item.description: Japanese tech titan SoftBank Group is launching an unusual $11 billion corporate bond offering. Engineered by visionary billionaire Masayoshi Son, this aggressive debt capital raise is earmarked for massive OpenAI backing and the race toward Artificial Superintelligence (ASI).
